clues.text: This champion came out from the Philistine camp standing six cubits and a span in height.
Facing Saul's army, this Philistine wore a bronze helmet and a bronze coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels.
Facing Israel, this Philistine champion carried a spear with a shaft like a weaver's beam and a heavy iron point.
A Philistine shouted to Saul's ranks to send one man to fight him, and the losing side would serve the winners.
Saul's men said the king would give riches, his daughter and a tax exemption to whoever killed this Philistine.
A stone taken from a bag and slung at this Philistine sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown.
Fleeing from Saul, David took this Philistine's sword from the priest Ahimelech, wrapped in cloth behind the ephod.
